stories.title: İstanbul'da çöken binada ölü sayısı 5'e yükseldi

en.title: Death toll in collapsed Istanbul building rises to 5
en.summary: The last person trapped under the rubble of a collapsed building in Istanbul's Maltepe district has been recovered. The death toll from the incident has reached 5.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA... Maltepe'de 7 katlı binanın 3 katı çöktü! Bir kişinin daha cansız bedenine ulaşıldı: Can kaybı 5'e ulaştı

en.title: 7-story building's 3 floors collapse in Istanbul's Maltepe; death toll reaches 5
en.summary: Three floors of a 7-story building collapsed in Istanbul's Maltepe district for an undetermined reason. Rescue operations have recovered 15 people from the rubble, with 5 confirmed dead.

en.title: First public execution in 90 years in the United States
en.summary: The U.S. Defense Secretary has announced that Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people in a 2009 Fort Hood attack, will be executed by firing squad.

en.title: Detention decision issued in fund investigation regarding colleague
en.summary: Istanbul's Chief Public Prosecutor's Office has ordered the detention of a SÖZCÜ TV presenter and author due to statements made regarding a fund investigation.

en.title: Blatant dignity executioner
en.summary: A politician from the New Party, Ümit Özlale, has targeted Family Minister Mahinur Özdemir Göktaş in criticism.

stories.title: Kesilmesin diye 70 gün boyunca başında nöbet tutmuşlardı: Asırlık ağaç kesildi

en.title: Century-old tree cut down despite 70-day vigil to prevent it
en.summary: A century-old tree in Arizona that environmental activists had protected for 70 days was cut down due to US border wall construction work.

en.title: Lawyer Güner, who embezzled funds from AHBAP, released
en.summary: Ece Güner, arrested on July 16 as part of an investigation into the AHBAP Association, has been released from custody.

en.title: 10-ton island left in city center canal
en.summary: Authorities in Boston, Massachusetts deposited an approximately 10-ton structure or landmass into the water canal running through the city center.

en.title: DEM's latest demands: Compensation and truth commission
en.summary: The DEM Party is requesting compensation payments for people injured and killed during migration from 20 provinces, including 2.3 million lira for families of deceased individuals.

stories.title: İzmir işgal altındadır o haindir ve kukladır

en.title: İzmir is under occupation, he is a traitor and a puppet
en.summary: A political figure expresses shame and regret about recent events, questioning whether they would have nominated a candidate had they known such misconduct would occur.

en.title: Drug operation in 3 provinces: 11 suspects arrested
en.summary: Following a three-month investigation coordinated by the Aydın Chief Public Prosecutor's Office, simultaneous operations were conducted at 63 addresses across Aydın, Muğla, and Denizli provinces.

stories.title: Aydın merkezli uyuşturucu operasyonu: 111 şüpheliden 11'i tutuklandı

en.title: Drug operation centered in Aydın: 11 of 111 suspects arrested
en.summary: A drug operation spanning three provinces resulted in 111 suspects being detained, with 11 of them arrested following the operation centered in Aydın.

en.title: Britain's borrowing costs at 19-year high
en.summary: UK government bond yields reached 5.527 percent, marking the highest level in 19 years, with long-term interest rates at their highest since 1998, increasing pressure on the government ahead of the October 28 budget announcement.

stories.title: ABD'den Microsoft'a yeşil kart engeli: 7 teknoloji devi daha listede

en.title: US blocks green card for Microsoft: 7 more tech giants on list
en.summary: The US administration suspended permanent residence applications for foreign workers at eight major technology companies including Microsoft and Adobe, affecting both new applications and pending cases.

stories.title: Küresel borsalarda satış baskısı büyüyor: Teknoloji hisseleri sert düştü

en.title: Global stock market selling pressure grows: Technology stocks fall sharply
en.summary: Technology stocks experienced sharp declines in the US while rising oil prices and bond yields pressured global markets. The Nasdaq dropped 1.3 percent and losses continued in Asia, with foreign investors notably selling 1.3 billion dollars worth of shares in India.

stories.title: Altında satış baskısına karşı rekor alım: Sırada ne var?

en.title: Record gold purchases counter selling pressure: What's next?
en.summary: World Gold Council data revealed a 2026 surprise in gold exchange-traded funds. UK-listed funds surpassed China with 9.5 billion dollars in inflows since year-start, while third-quarter demand reached 54 tons.

stories.title: Maltepe'deki enkazda 1 kişinin cansız bedenine ulaşıldı

en.title: One body found in rubble in Maltepe
en.summary: Search and rescue operations continue at a seven-story building that collapsed in Maltepe. The body of Mesut Bilecen, one of three people still being sought, has been recovered from the rubble.
